title: MiLe Loss: a New Entropy-Weighed Loss for Mitigating the Bias of Learning Difficulties in Large Language Models

bias_targets.target: Bias of learning difficulties (Token frequency bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Grouping tokens into different frequency buckets (high, medium, and low) based on their occurrence in the training corpus, and analyzing the average perplexity (PPL) of the language model for tokens in each bucket to demonstrate that infrequent tokens have a higher learning difficulty.

primary_bias_target: Bias of learning difficulties (Token frequency bias)
